text:
ashwin: quick ask — sales needs a very short demo tomorrow and they asked for a temporary burst raise for org `redwood-poc` (api_key: demo-abc). can we do a short-lived allowlist/override?

maria: need ticket + org id. what peak rps are they expecting? any PII concerns?

kevin-sales: it's a hosted product demo, peak ~300rps for ~8 minutes, mostly chat completions. no customer data in the demo. contact is acme demo team.

olivia: policy preference: prefer key-scoped exceptions over org-wide ones to avoid collateral. support UI today only supports org-level exceptions though.

cory: technically we can scope by api_key_id in the overrides table and enforce TTL. would require small support-api change and audit metadata.

ashwin: proposal: create an ephemeral allowlist entry tied to the api_key_id with fields: max_burst_rps=400, window=10m, ttl=30m, require audit_log + ticket link. also wire a telemetry alert: errors>1% or p95 latency>1200ms -> revoke/notify.

maria: i can create a manual org-level exception via internal tool today but not per-key. is support comfortable making a key-scoped change if we add a flag on the payload?

kevin-sales: minimal friction is key for us. if support can do it with a short playbook, sales can proceed.

olivia: security note — do NOT disable rate limiting entirely. use a token-bucket with a hard cap. every overridden request must be logged with reason=`demo-allowlist` and ticket id.

cory: dev plan (short): add POST /internal/overrides that accepts {api_key_id, max_burst, ttl_minutes, ticket_url, created_by}. enforcement reads overrides at request-time and applies token-bucket params. fallback to org-level if not found. for now i'll add a stopgap script support can run.

support-bot: deploy-bot: applied override for api_key demo-abc; max_burst=400 RPS; window=10m; expires in 00:30:00; ticket=#12345; created_by=maria

maria: ticket #12345 created and audit entry added. i'll watch metrics during demo. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/team/eng-platform/d/abc123/rate-limits

ashwin: please also add a guard rule: if token consumption > 100k in 15m -> auto-revoke and page eng-oncall.

olivia: agreed. add security@redwood to the notification list for visibility.

cory: i'll open a small PR to add the overrides endpoint, TTL enforcement, and audit fields. ETA: EOD. will include unit tests and a migration for the overrides table. cc @ashwin

kevin-sales: perfect — please confirm once active, thanks everyone 🙏

support-bot: monitor-bot: alert configured: demo-abc -> errors>1% OR p95>1200ms -> notify #eng-oncall, @maria, security@redwood; auto-revoke if consumption>100k in 15m

maria: monitoring now, will post a short post-mortem in ticket after demo.

ashwin: closing loop — leave notes in ticket about outcome and whether we should standardize a documented flow for future ephemeral sales/demo requests.
